replies.author: Howsie
replies.body:
Alright.

If you haven't noticed avicus doesn't exactly have a populous of note anymore. Therefore it is only logical that having excessive positions not only serves little point, but also over-complicates things for both the community and the staff. My argument, therefore, is that you ought to steamline the ranks. Cut all the labels and bring everything into the 'staff member category'. Have being a map developer (or as I'd have it renamed a member of the 'mapping and yamalling committee' a sub-category of the moderator team. Same goes for officials and referees; pointless ranks bootlegging off popular servers that require the labelling.

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
I don't think a rank necessarily should be abolished because we have a lower player count than before -- I honestly don't know where advertising efforts are, but if anything, I will try my hand at it with a few others if there's no backup. 

The "excessive positions" I thought of, when I first made the idea of junior mapdev and head mapdev, were for more internal organization and structure. The head map developer role has exceeded beyond my expectations, and it has grown to be like a "mini-admin" in the team without bothering the admins, and so far, all the policies and stuff written has been very beneficial to how things work. The one thing I'd say Avicus has over other servers is map development structure, which was well-formed especially by the veterans.

Also, I don't really recall having any issues with it complicating the community, because we made junior map developer so we could get an idea how they would work with others without throwing permissions on them. Some of the candidates we thought of either made it or didn't, and we got some really cool ones through it. Imagine if the repository was griefed, we can't have that. We really do look extensively through them and their behavior, and the team makes a decision. Honestly, the rank is for the community, and I've not seen many complaints on it.

I can mention it to Sli, but other than that, I don't really know if the rank is very detrimental to the server to keep. We got a little better, even, when we first added the junior map developer rank.

EDIT: By removing referee and official ranks, we wouldn't have tournaments. We need them for internal things, and representation to know who to ask and who to talk to is always important; also necessary in Teamspeak among other services. The committees always failed terribly, and I'm sure you know it; we tried for months, and out of all the 5 we ever had, each one died out. I prefer our structure.
